ष: ष The thirty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, and second sibilant, corresponding to Sh, pronounced in some schools Kh: this letter is usually the first element of the roots, the derivatives of which commence with स.

ष mfn. (षः-षा-षं) Best, excellent. m. (षः) 1 A learned man, a teacher. 2 A nipple. 3 Loss, destruction. 4 Rest, remainder. 5 Loss of knowledge previously acquired. 6 Eternal happiness, final emancipation. 7 Heaven, paradise. 8 Sleep. 9 End, term. n. (-षं) 1 The embryo. 2 Patience, endurance. E. षो to destroy, &c., aff. क or ड and the consonant unchanged, &c.
षग: षग (ए) षगे r. 1st cl. (सगति) To cover: also written सग.
षघ: षघ r. 5th cl. (सघ्नोति) To hurt or kill: also सघ.
षच: षच r. 1st cl. (सचते) 1 To wet, to moisten, to sprinkle. 2 To serve, to gratify by service. (सचति) 1 To be connected. 2 To understand thoroughly.
षञ्ज: षञ्ज r. 1st cl. (सजति) To embrace, to cling or adhere to, to be in contact or connexion with. With अव prefixed, to hand down from, to be suspended. With वि and आङ्, to struggle together. With आङ्, to be attached or devoted to. (उ) षञ्जु r. 1st cl. (सञ्जति-ते) To go.
षट: षट r. 1st cl. (सटति) To be a part or portion.
षट्क: षट्क mfn. (-ट्कः-ट्का-ट्कं) 1 Six. 2 Having six, six-fold, &c. E. षष् six, and कन् poss. aff.
षट्कर्ण: षट्कर्ण m. (-र्णः) A sort of lute. E. षष् six, and कर्ण an ear.
षट्कर्मन्: षट्कर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 A Brahman. 2 An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.) n. (-र्म्म or pl. र्म्माणि) 1 The six acts proper for a Brahman, (collectively,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conducting them for others, giving, accepting gifts. 2 Six acts allowable to a Brahman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, asking alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest. 3 The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty. E. षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.
षट्कर्म्मन्: षट्कर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) 1 A Brahman. 2 An adept, (in the Tantras, &c.) n. (-र्म्म or pl. र्म्माणि) 1 The six acts proper for a Brahman, (collectively,) or teaching the Vedas, holy study, offering sacrifices, conducting them for others, giving, accepting gifts. 2 Six acts allowable to a Brahman for subsistence, or gleaning, accepting gifts, asking alms, agriculture, trade, and tending cattle, or according to some lending money at interest. 3 The six acts taught in the Tantras, or killing, infatuating, enthralling, expelling, exciting animosity, and the stopping or privation of any faculty. E. षष् six, कर्म्मन् act or duty.
षट्कोण: षट्कोण n. (-णं) 1 A hexagon, a six-angled figure. 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. E. षष् six, कोण a corner.
षट्चरण: षट्चरण m. (-णः) A bee. E. षष् six, and चरण a foot.
षट्ट: षट्ट r. 10th cl. (षट्टयति) 1 To injure, to hurt or kill. 2 To give. 3 To be strong. 4 To dwell.
षट्त्रिंशत्: षट्त्रिंशत् f. (-शत्) 1 Thirty-six. 2 A work on law. E. षष् six, and त्रिंशत् thirty.
षट्पद: षट्पद m. (-दः) A bee. mf. (-दः-दी) A louse. E. षष् six, and पद a foot.
षट्पदप्रिय: षट्पदप्रिय m. (-यः) The Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.) E. षट्पद a bee, and प्रिय beloved by; equally applicable therefore to the lotus, jasmine, &c.
षट्पदातिथि: षट्पदातिथि m. (-थिः) 1 The mango tree. 2 The Champaka. E. षट्पद a bee, अतिथि a guest.
षट्प्रज्ञ: षट्प्रज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) 1 A sage, one acquainted with the four objects of human existence, or virtue, wealth, desire, and final happiness, and with the nature of the world, and of divine truth. 2 A catamite. E. षष् six, and प्रज्ञ who knows.
षडक्षीण: षडक्षीण m. (-णः) A fish. E. षष् six, and अक्षि the eye, ख aff.
षडङ्ग: षडङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) 1 Having six limbs or members. 2 Having six parts, six ingredients, &c. n. (-ङ्गं) 1 Six parts of the body collectively; as the two arms, two legs, and the head, and waist. 2 The six supplementary parts of the Vedas, or grammar, prosody, astronomy, pronunciation, the meaning of unusual terms, and the ritual of the Hindu religion. E. षष् six, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
षडङ्गजित्: षडङ्गजित् m. (-जित्) VIṢṆU. E. षडङ्ग the six members, and जित् who subdues.
षडङ्गपानीय: षडङ्गपानीय n. (-यं) A infusion or decoction of six drugs. E. षडङ्ग, and पानीय drink.
षडङ्घ्रि: षडङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A bee. E. षष् six, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.
षडभिज्ञ: षडभिज्ञ m. (-ज्ञ;) A Buddha or Bauddha deified sage. E. षष् six, (branches of learning or piety,) and अभिज्ञ understanding.
षडानन: षडानन m. (-नः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and आनन a face; having six faces, four directed to the four cardinal points, and two to the zenith and nadir, according to some accounts, though not generally so represented.
षडूषण: षडूषण n. (-णं) Six spices collectively, or long-pepper, black-pepper, dried ginger, the root of long-pepper, the fruit of the plumbago, and of the Piper chavya. E. षष् six, and ऊषण a spice.
षडृतु: षडृतु m. plur. (-तवः) The six seasons; also personified as divinities. E. षष्, and ऋतु a season.
षङ्गव: षङ्गव n. (-वं) A yoke of six oxen, or six oxen collectively. E. षष् six, and गो an ox, अच् added.
षड्गुण: षड्गुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Six-fold, six times. n. (-णं) An assemblage of six qualities or properties. mf. (-णः-णा) The six acts of a king, in his military character, or peace, war, marching, halting, sowing dissension, seeking protection. E. षष्, and गुण a time.
षड्ग्रन्थ: षड्ग्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) A variety of the Cæsalpinia bonducella. f. (-न्था) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) E. षष् six, ग्रन्थि a knot.
षड्ग्रन्थिका: षड्ग्रन्थिका f. (-का) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet.) E. षड्ग्रन्थ as above, and कन् added.
षड्ज: षड्ज m. (-ड्जः) The fourth note of the Hindu gamut. E. षष् six, and ज born: supposed to require for its articulation the employment of the tongue, teeth, palate, nose, throat, and chest.
षड्धा: षड्धा ind. In six ways. E. षष् six, and धाच् aff.
षड्भाग: षड्भाग m. (-गः) A sixth, a sixth part. E. षष्, and भाग share.
षड्भागभाज्: षड्भागभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Entitled to a sixth. E. षड्भाग, and भाज् who shares.
षड्भुज: षड्भुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Six-armed, six-sided. m. (-जः) A hexagon. f. (-जा) The water-melon. E. षष् six, भुज an arm or branch, &c., aff. टाप्.
षड्रेखा: षड्रेखा f. (-खा) A water-melon. E. षष् six, and रेखा a line.
षड्वर्ग: षड्वर्ग m. (-र्गः) A class or aggregate of six, as of six defects, desire, wrath, covetousness, bewilderment, pride, and envy. E. षष् six, and वर्ग a class.
षड्वर्गवश्य: षड्वर्गवश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Subject to the six vices. E. षड्वर्ग, and वश्य to be subjected.
षड्विध: षड्विध mfn. (-घः-घा-धं) In six ways, of six kinds. E. षष्, and विध kind.
षड्विन्दु: षड्विन्दु m. (-न्दुः) VIṢṆU. E. षष् six, and विन्दु a drop or spot.
षण: षण (उ) षणु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) 1 To give. 2 To serve or honor; also written षन.
षण्ड: षण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bull at liberty. 2 A eunuch. 3 A multitude, a heap. mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) A quantity of lotuses. E. षण to give, ड Uṇādi aff.; also शण्ड, षण्ढ, and शण्ड, &c.
षण्डाली: षण्डाली f. (-ली) 1 A measure of oil, the vessel holding a Chitank. 2 A wanton woman. 3 A pond, a pool. E. षण्ड a bull, a eunuch, &c., and अल to be able, affs. अच् and ङीप्.
षण्ढ: षण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) A eunuch: see षण्ड.
षण्मास: षण्मास m. (-सः) A half year, six months. E. षष्, and मास a month.
षण्मास्य: षण्मास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Six months old, of six months standing, &c. E. षण्मास, and यत् aff.; also षाण्मास्य.
षण्मुख: षण्मुख m. (-खः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and मुख face.
षत्वणत्व: षत्वणत्व n. (-त्वं) The substitution of the letters ष or ण for स, and न in grammatical derivatives. E. ष and ण the letters, with the abstract affix attached to each respectively.
षद: षद (औ ॡ) औषदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (सीदति) 1 To wither, to wane, to perish gradually. 2 To be low-spirited, to despond, to be weary or distressed, to lack energy. 3 To break or destroy. 4 To go or move. With आङ् prefixed, औषदॢ r. 1st and 10th cls. (आसादति आसादयति) 1 To go. 2 To assail, to encounter. With अव prefixed, 1 To be exhausted or languid. 2 To finish. With आङ्, To obtain, to attain, to reach or arrive at. With उत्, 1 To ascend. 2 To destroy. With उप, To approach. With नि, 1 To sit in or on. 2 To stand. 3 To protect. With प्र, 1 To be propitious to, to favour or be pleased with. 2 To please or propitiate. 3 To purify. 4 To smile. With वि, To be languid or sorrowful. With सम्, 1 To attain. 2 To be in company or society with.
षध: षध r. 5th cl. (षध्नोति) To wish to hurt or kill.
षन: षन (उ) षनु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते) To give; also षण.
षप: षप r. 1st cl. (सपति) 1 To be connected. 2 To understand thoroughly.
षम: षम r. 1st cl. (समति) 1 To be unconfused. 2 To be confused. r. 10th cl. (समयति) To perplex or distress.
षम्ब: षम्ब r. 1st cl. (सम्बति) To go, to move. r. 10th cl. (सम्बयति) To unite, to join, to collect or assemble together; also read सम्ब.
षर्ज: षर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To earn, to acquire.
षर्ज्ज: षर्ज्ज r. 1st cl. (सर्ज्जति) To earn, to acquire.
षर्व: षर्व r. 1st cl. (सर्वति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To injure, to hurt.
षल: षल r. 1st cl. (सलति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To shake.
षष्: षष् mfn. plu. only (षट् or षड्) Six.
षष्टि: षष्टि f. (-ष्ठिः) Sixty. E. षष् six, डटि aff.
षष्टिक: षष्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bought with sixty. mf. (-कः-का) A kind of rice of quick growth. E. षष् six, (days,) ठन् aff. or षष्ठि sixty, and कन् added.
षष्टिक्य: षष्टिक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Fit for rice of quick growth, (a field, &c.) E. षष्टिक, and यन् aff.
षष्टितम: षष्टितम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Sixtieth. E. षष्टि sixty, and तमट् aff.
षष्टिधा: षष्टिधा ind. In sixty ways. E. षष्टि sixty, and धा aff.
षष्ठ: षष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth. f. (-ष्ठी) 1 DURGĀ. 2 The sixth day of the lunar fortnight. E. षष् six, डटि aff., and थुक् augment.
षष्ठक: षष्ठक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sixth. E. कन् added to the last.
षष्ठान्न: षष्ठान्न n. (-न्नं) A sixth meal, i. e. one in three days. E. षष्ठ, and अन्न food.
षष्ठान्नकाल: षष्ठान्नकाल n. (-लं) The taking of food once in three days, as an act of penance. E. षष्ठान्न, and काल time; also with कन् added, षष्ठान्नकालकं.
षष्ठान्नकालता: षष्ठान्नकालता f. (-ता) Eating once in three days, on the evening of the third day. E. षष्ठान्नकाल, and तल् aff.
षष्ठिन्: षष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Being or having the sixth (year, &c.) E. षष्ठ, and इनि poss. aff.
षष्ठिमत्त: षष्ठिमत्त m. (-त्तः) An elephant. E. षष्ठि sixth, (year,) and मत्त furious.
षष्ठिहायन: षष्ठिहायन m. (-नः) 1 An elephant. 2 A kind of rice. E. षष्ठि sixth, हायन a year: then full grown.
षस्ज: षस्ज r. 1st cl. (सज्जति) To move, to go.
षस्ति: षस्ति r. 2nd cl. (सस्ति) To sleep, (this is not universally considered to be a root.)
षह: षह r. 1st cl. (सहते) r. 4th cl. (सह्यति) 1st and 10th cls. (सहति साहयति.) 1 To bear, to endure, to suffer or support, to forbear, to have patience. 2 To be content or satisfied. 3 To be able. With उत् prefixed, 1 To make effort or exertion, to persevere, to energize. 2 To be happy or delighted. With प्र, To be violent. With वि, To determine.
षाट्: षाट् ind. An interjection of calling.
षाट्कौशिक: षाट्कौशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Enveloped in six sheathes. E. षट्, and कोश a sheath, ठक् aff.
षाडव: षाडव m. (-वः) 1 Sentiment, passion. 2 Singing, music.
षाड्गुण्य: षाड्गुण्य n. (-ण्यं) 1 An aggregate of six properties or qualities. 2 The six acts of royal military policy. 3 Increase or multiplication, six-fold. E. षङ्गुण, and यञ् aff.
षाण्मातुर: षाण्मातुर m. (-रः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. षष् six, and मातृ a mother, अण् aff.; having been brought up by the six Kṛttikās.
षाण्मासिक: षाण्मासिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to six months, half yearly, &c. E. षण्मास, and ठञ् aff.
षात्वणत्विक: षात्वणत्विक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relative to the substitution of ष or ण for स and न, (as a rule, &c.) E. ठक् added to षत्वणत्व as above.
षाध: षाध (उ) साधु r. 4th cl. (साध्यति) 1 To effect, to accomplish or complete. 2 To succeed; also साध.
षान्त्व: षान्त्व r. 10th cl. (सान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort; also सान्त्व.
षाष्ठ: षाष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं) Sixth. E. षष्ठ the same, and अञ् aff.
षि: षि (ञ्) षिञ् r. 5th cl. (सिनोति सिनुते) r. 9th cl. (सिनातिसिनीते) To tie, to bind. With अधि and अव prefixed, To accomplish. With वि and अव, To transact as business. With वि, To be an object or purpose.
षिच: षिच (औ) षिचा r. 6th cl. (सिञ्चति-ते) To sprinkle. With अभि prefixed, 1 To anoint, to initiate. 2 To sprinkle.
षिट: षिट r. 1st cl. (सिटति) To disregard, to contemn, to despise, to treat with disrespect.
षिड्ग: षिड्ग m. (-ड्गः) 1 A catamite. 2 A libertine, a lecher. 3 A gallant. E. षिट to despise, Uṇādi aff. गन.
षिध: षिध r. 1st cl. (सेधति) To go. (ऊ) षिधू r. 1st cl. (सेधति) 1 To command, to order. 2 To ordain, especially with respect to holy observances. 2 To do an auspicious act. or one indicating good fortune. (उ) षिध r. 4th cl. (सिध्यति) 1 To succeed, to effect fully or completely. 2 To complete a series of mystical observances by which supernatural powers are attained, to be an adept, to be initiated. 2 To be perfect, to be finished or accomplished. 4 To be right or correct. With नि or प्रति prefixed, (निषेधति प्रतिषेधति) To prevent, to prohibit. With प्र, To be celebrated or notorious.
षिभ: षिभ (उ) षिभु r. 1st cl. (सेभति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To speak. 3 To shine.
षिम्भ: षिम्भ (उ) षिम्भु r. 1st cl. (सिम्भति) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To speak. 3 To shine.
षिल: षिल r. 6th cl. (सिलति) To glean: more usually सिल.
षिव: षिव (उ) षिवु r. 4th cl. (सीव्यति) 1 To sew, to stitch. 3 To sow, as seed.
षु: षु r. 2nd cl. (सौति) 1 To bear, to bring forth. 2 To possess power or supremacy. (ञ) षुञ् r. 5th cl. (सुनोति सुनुते) 1 To bathe, preparatory to a sacrifice. 2 To distil, to extract a spirit. 3 To churn, to stir or agitate. 4 To pain. With अभि, 1 To sprinkle. 2 To bathe. With प्र, To bear or bring forth.
षुट्ट: षुट्ट r. 10th cl. (सुट्टयति) 1 To disregard, to despise. 2 To be small or shallow.
षुभ: षुभ r. 1st cl. (सोभति) r. 6th cl. (सुभति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. 3 To hurt or kill.
षुम्भ: षुम्भ r. 1st and 6th cls. (सुम्भति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine. 3 To be beautiful. 4 To hurt or kill.
षुर: षुर r. 6th cl. (सुरति) 1 To possess supreme or superhuman power. 2 To shine.
षुह: षुह r. 4th cl. (सुह्यति) 1 To bear, to endure. 2 To be content or satisfied. 3 To be able.
षू: षू (ङ) षूङ् r. 2nd cl. (सूते) r. 4th cl. (सूयते) 1 To bear a child, to bring forth. 2 To produce in general. r. 6th cl. (सुवति) To direct, to send, to throw or cast.
षू f. (-षूः) Birth, delivery, child-bearing. E. षू to bring forth, aff. क्विप्, and the consonant unchanged.
षूद: षूद r. 1st cl. (सूदते) r. 10th cl. (सूदयति) 1 To leak, to drop, to flow, to distil. 2 To deposit, to place. 3 To hurt, to wound, to kill or attempt to kill. 4 To promise. 5 (In the causal form,) To hallow, to make holy or pure.
षूर: षूर (ई) षूरी r. 4th cl. (सूर्य्यते) 1 To be stopped or fixed. 2 To hurt or kill.
षूर्क्ष: षूर्क्ष r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्षति) 1 To respect, to regard, to treat with reverence or respect. 2 To disregard, to disrespect.
षूर्क्ष्य: षूर्क्ष्य r. 1st cl. (सूर्क्ष्यति) 1 To envy, to be impatient of another's rise. 2 To be intolerant or impatient of another's faults. 3 To disregard or contemn.
षूष: षूष r. 1st cl. (सूषति) To bring forth, to bear; also सूष.
षृभ: षृभ (उ) षृभु r. 1st cl. (सर्भति) To hurt or kill.
षृम्भ: षृम्भ (उ) षृम्भु r. 1st cl. (सृम्भति) To hurt or kill.
षेक: षेक (ऋ) षेकृ r. 1st cl. (सेकते) To go, to move; preferably सेक.
षेल: षेल (ऌ) षेलृ r. 1st cl. (सेलति) To go, to move; also शेल, and सेल.
षेव: षेव (ऋ) षेवृ r. 1st cl. (सेवति-ते) 1 To serve, to gratify by service. 2 To rely or depend on. 3 To worship. 4 To follow, to practise, to be addicted to.
षै: षै r. 1st cl. (सायति) To waste, to wane or decline.
षो: षो r. 4th cl. (स्यति) 1 To destroy, to put an end to. 2 To be destroyed, to perish.
षोडत्: षोडत् m. (-डन्) A young ox, or one with six teeth. E. षष् six, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
षोडश: षोडश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Sixteenth. E. शोडशन् sixteen, डट् aff.
षोडशक: षोडशक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sixteen, (collectively.) E. शोडश, and कन् added.
षोडशन्: षोडशन् mfn. plu. only. (-श) Sixteen. E. षष् six, and दशन् ten.
षोडशर्तुनिशा: षोडशर्त्तुनिशा f. (-शा) Any one of sixteen nights from the commencement of menstruation. E. शोडश, and ऋतु menses, निशा night.
षोडशर्त्तुनिशा: षोडशर्त्तुनिशा f. (-शा) Any one of sixteen nights from the commencement of menstruation. E. शोडश, and ऋतु menses, निशा night.
षोडशांश: षोडशांश m. (-शः) A sixteenth. E. शोडश, and अंश part.
षोडशांशु: षोडशांशु m. (-शुः) The planet VENUS. E. शोडश sixteen, and अंशु a ray.
षोडशाङ्घ्रि: षोडशाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) A crab. E. षोडश sixteen, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.
षोडशार्चिस्: षोडशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet VENUS. E. षोडश sixteen, and अर्च्चिस् a ray.
षोडशार्च्चिस्: षोडशार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet VENUS. E. षोडश sixteen, and अर्च्चिस् a ray.
षोडषावर्त्त: षोडषावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A conch shell. E. षोडश sixteen, and आवर्त्त a twist or spire.
षोडा: षोडा ind. In six ways. E. षष six, उ substituted for the final, धा aff., and ध changed to ड.
ष्टक: ष्टक r. 1st cl. (स्तकति) To resist or oppose.
ष्टग: ष्टग (ए) ष्टगे r. 1st cl. (स्तगति) To cover.
ष्टभ: ष्टभ (इ) ष्टभि r. 1st cl. (स्तम्भते) 1 To stop or hinder, to oppose, to impede, to resist or prevent. 2 To be stupid or dull, to be inanimate or insensible. 3 To be fixed as a post. 4 To be astounded or stupefied. 5 To be paralysed.
ष्टम: ष्टम r. 1st. cl. (स्तमति) 1 To be confused. 2 To be clear or unconfused. r. 10th cl. (स्तमयति) To confuse or annoy.
ष्टिघ: ष्टिघ r. 5th cl. (स्तिघ्नुते) To assail, to assault, to attack.
ष्टिप: ष्टिप (ऋ) ष्टिपृ r. 1st cl. (स्तेपते) 1 To ooze, to drop, to distil. 2 To sprinkle.
ष्टिम: ष्टिम r. 4th cl. (स्तिम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
ष्टीम: ष्टीम r. 4th cl. (स्तीम्यति) To be wet or moist, to reek, to steam.
ष्टु: ष्टु (ञ) ष्टुञ् r. 2nd cl. (स्तौति or स्तुते स्तवीति or स्तवीते) 1 To praise, to eulogise. 2 To hymn, to worship with praises.
ष्टुच: ष्टुच r. 1st cl. (स्तोचते) To be clear, to be bright, to be pellucid.
ष्टुप: ष्टुप r. 10th cl. (स्तोपयति) To heap up.
ष्टुभ: ष्टुभ (उ) ष्टुभु r. 1st cl. (स्तोभति) 1 To stop, to hinder. 2 To be stupid or dull.
ष्टूप: ष्टूप r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति) To heap together, to pile up, to collect into a heap; also स्तूप.
ष्टृक्ष: ष्टृक्ष r. 1st cl. (स्तृक्षति) To go, to move.
ष्टृह: ष्टृह (उ) ष्टृहु r. 6th cl. (ष्टृहति) To hurt or kill; also स्तृह, and ष्टृह.
ष्टॄह: ष्टॄह (ऊ) ष्टॄहू r. 6th cl. (स्तृहति) To hurt or kill.
ष्टेप: ष्टेप (ऋ) ष्टेपृ r. 1st cl. (स्तेपते) 1 To leak, to flow, to distil or drop. 2 To sprinkle.
ष्टै: ष्टै r. 1st cl. (स्तायति) To surround, to encompass.
ष्ट्यै: ष्ट्यै r. 1st cl. (स्त्यायति) 1 To sound. 2 To crowd or swarm. 3 To envelope.
ष्ठग: ष्ठग (ए) ष्ठगे r. 1st cl. (स्थगति) To cover.
ष्ठल: ष्ठल r. 1st cl. (स्थलति) 1 To stand. 2 To be firm.
ष्ठस: ष्ठस (उ) ष्ठसु r. 4th cl. (स्थस्यति) To dwell in, to inhabit.
ष्ठा: ष्ठा r. 1st cl. (तिष्ठति) 1 To stand, to stop, to be still, to refrain from moving. 2 To abide, to stay, to be. (तिष्ठते) 1 To apply or refer to, as an umpire or judge. 2 To indicate or reveal one's thoughts to another. With अधि prefixed, (अधितिष्ठति) 1 To excel, to surpass, to overcome. 2 To sit or stand upon or over. 3 To be placed or preside over. With अनु (अनुतिष्ठति) 1 To practise as a duty, to obey or follow as a law. 2 To apply or adhere to. With अव (अवतिष्ठति-ते) 1 To stay or stand. 2 To attend upon. With आङ् (आतिष्ठते) 1 To affirm or assert. 2 To apply; (आतिष्ठति) 1 To ascend, to mount. 2 To promise or engage. With उत् (उत्तिष्ठते) 1 To seek for, to endeavour to obtain; (उत्तिष्ठति) To get up, to rise as from a seat, &c. With उप (उपतिष्ठति-ते) 1 To propitiate (as a deity.) 2 To praise or hymn, to worship, to adore. 3 To embrace. 4 To treat in a friendly manner, to form a friendship or connexion with. 5 To pass or lie along or near to, that is, as a path or road. 6 To arrive at or near; (उपतिष्ठते) To hope to gain or acquire. With नि (नितिष्ठते) To be established. With परि and अव (पर्य्यवतिष्ठते) To be stationary or immovable. With प्र (प्रतिष्ठते) 1 To set off, to go forth, to depart. 2 To go to. With प्र and उत् (प्रोत्तिष्ठति) To get up, to rise. With प्रति, (प्रतितिष्ठति) To be erected for holy purposes, to be sacred or consecrated. With वि (वितिष्ठते) 1 To stand apart, to be separated. 2 To stay or be. With वि and अव (व्यवतिष्ठते) To decree, to pronounce. With सम् (सन्तिष्ठते) 1 To be well. 2 To be close to or together. 3 To be of the same inclinations or opinions, to conform, to agree. 4 To be completed or finished. With सम and आङ् (समातिष्ठते) To perform, to be engaged in. With सम and उत् (समुत्तिष्ठति) To rise or get up. With सम and प्र, To go forth or on a journey. With प्र in the causal (प्रस्थापयति) To send.
ष्ठिव: ष्ठिव (उ) ष्ठिवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) r. 4th cl. (ष्ठीव्यति) To eject from the mouth, to spit, to sputter, (the radical sibilant is unchanged in this root;) also ष्ठीव.
ष्ठीव: ष्ठीव (उ) ष्ठीवु r. 1st cl. (ष्ठीवति) To spit or eject from the mouth.
ष्ठीवन: ष्ठीवन n. (-नं) 1 Spitting, ejecting saliva. 2 Saliva, spittle. E. ष्ठीव, and ल्युट् aff.
ष्ठीवित्वा: ष्ठीवित्वा ind. Having spitten. E. ष्ठीव to spit, क्त्वा aff.
ष्ठ्युत: ष्ठ्युत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ejected as saliva, spit. E. ष्ठीव to spit, क्त aff.
ष्णस: ष्णस (उ) ष्णसु r. 4th cl. (स्नस्यति) To eject from the mouth, to spit.
ष्णा: ष्णा r. 2nd cl. (स्नाति) To bathe, to purify by ablution.
ष्णिह: ष्णिह (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्निह्यति) To bear affection to, love, to regard, to be kind to or pleased with. r. 10th. cl. (स्नेहयति) To be unctuous, to be bland or greasy.
ष्णु: ष्णु r. 2nd cl. (ष्णौति) To distil, to drop, to ooze or leak.
ष्णुच: ष्णुच r. 1st cl. (स्नोचते) To be clear or pellucid.
ष्णुस: ष्णुस (उ) ष्णुसु r. 4th cl. (स्नुस्यति) 1 To eat. 2 To take. 3 To disappear. 4 To eject from the mouth.
ष्णुह: ष्णुह (ऌ ऊ) r. 4th cl. (स्नुह्यति) To be sick, to retch, to throw up, to vomit.
ष्णै: ष्णै r. 1st cl. (स्नायति) To surround, to encompass.
ष्मि: ष्मि r. 1st cl. (स्मयते) To smile. r. 10th cl. (स्नाययते) To disrespect: with वि prefixed, to surprise or astonish.
ष्वक्क: ष्वक्क r. 1st cl. (ष्वक्कते) To go, to move.
ष्वद: ष्वद r. 1st cl. (स्वदते) r. 10th cl. (स्वादयति) 1 To taste. 2 To be pleasing. 3 To cover; also स्वाद.
ष्वप: ष्वप (ञि औ) ञिष्वपौ r. 2nd cl. (स्वपिति) To sleep.
ष्वर्त्त: ष्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (ष्वर्त्तयति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To be wretched or distressed.
ष्वष्क: ष्वष्क r. 1st cl. (ष्वष्कते) To go, to move: the radical sibilant is unchanged.
ष्विद: ष्विद (ञि आ) ञिष्विदा r. 1st cl. (स्वेदते) r. 4th cl. (स्विद्यति) 1 To perspire, to sweat. 2 To be greasy or unctuous. 3 To be fascinated, to be tempted or deluded. 4 To quit, to yield. स
